name: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) API v3 search
owner: Publications Office of the European Union (TED)
gives: EU public procurement notices (contract notices and award notices) with buyer, subject, value, place of performance

why.quote: TED API allows anonymous access to all services manipulating published notices (i.e., searching for or retrieving notices already published on TED).
why.basis: API documentation (anonymous access to published notices; 'The Search API does not require a key'); the TED legal notice and reuse terms were not readable (ted.europa.eu answered HTTP 202 to a plain request, which reads as a bot check, so it is a gap); api.ted.europa.eu/robots.txt returns 404

interface: POST https://api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search with JSON {query, fields, limit, page, scope}, for example query 'organisation-country-buyer=PRT'; returns JSON with notice-identifier, publication-date, buyer-name and links to XML and PDF. No key for search.
notes: Keyless for search; probed once on 2026-11-18 (two Portuguese buyers returned). Reuse licence and rate limits not read: the legal notice page was behind a bot check, so someone should read the terms by hand before building. Privacy rule: buyers and winners may be public bodies or companies, but sole traders and individuals appear as winners, so a collector must keep only organisations and never name a natural person, as for the Portuguese contracts. Notices cover contracts above EU thresholds only, so most small Portuguese contracts (see BASE) are not here.
